upgrade_to_3.5.1.note: CORRECTION to the task's simplified claim ('migrated to 3.5.1 should only need iterations->rng, seed->rng; NOT a SpaceRenderer change'; '3.4.2 should only change iterations->rng'). Empirically: SpaceRenderer.setup_agents() did NOT exist at 3.3.1, so F5 must use SpaceRenderer(...).render(agent_portrayal). That render(portrayal) call is clean on 3.3.1 but becomes a PendingDeprecationWarning starting at 3.4 (verified on 3.4.2 and 3.5.1: 'Passing parameters to render() is deprecated. Use setup_structure(), setup_agents()...'). Therefore a real upgrade to EITHER 3.4.2 or 3.5.1 must also switch render(agent_portrayal) to the setup_agents() chain. This is a method-call change on the same SpaceRenderer class (not a class swap; discrete_space and the class itself stay). PendingDeprecationWarning matches the runner's warning regex and IS shown under PYTHONWARNINGS=default, so it would be flagged if F5 were run on 3.4+/3.5 - which is exactly why this fixture's runs_on is 3.3.1, where render(portrayal) is clean.
